foundation: the staged OCR dispatch foundation unit (#2034): its defineOcrAdapter takes the spec, its createOcrDispatcher runs it; this module imports neither

source.endpointResolution: src/app/api/v1/ocr/route.ts resolveOcrCredentials: top-level baseUrl, else providerSpecificData.baseUrl
ported: Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key carries the connection key on the submit and every poll
body { urlSource } for a document URL, { base64Source } for a data URL (azureDiSource)
pollUrl from the Operation-Location header, polled on the submit origin only
poll status succeeded returns the answer, failed is a failure (pollOcrOperation)
analyzeResult.content mirrored into one aggregated page at index 0; usage_info.pages_processed from analyzeResult.pages
the single listed model prebuilt-read; provider/model prefix and bare id
notPorted: the source prefix passthrough of any model id after azure-document-intelligence/: only prebuilt-read is supported
the source model field hardcoded to prebuilt-read in parseResponse: the requested model is reported
accessToken as the subscription key (source token = accessToken || apiKey): only apiKey is a subscription key
pages_processed defaulting to 1 when analyzeResult.pages is missing: accounting falls back to the returned page count, which is the same 1
per-page splitting of content (the source returns one aggregated page)
Mistral, Vertex DeepSeek OCR and every other OCR_PROVIDERS entry (separate units)

intentionalContractChanges: the endpoint must be a bare https origin on an Azure AI services host (*.cognitiveservices.azure.com, .azure.us, .azure.cn or *.api.cognitive.microsoft.com) with no path, query, fragment, userinfo or port; the source sends the key to any configured base URL
the key is sent only when the selected connection's own endpoint equals the endpoint the adapter was built for; otherwise 401 before anything is sent

a missing or non-202 submit answer without a same-origin Operation-Location of the form /documentintelligence/documentModels/{model}/analyzeResults/{id} is a lost result (accepted), never read as a synchronous answer
analyze states notStarted and running keep polling; failed and canceled fail; any other state is a lost result
inline documents are limited to PDF, PNG, JPEG and TIFF; WebP and GIF are refused before anything is sent
a succeeded answer without string analyzeResult.content is a lost result, not an empty page

exports.azureDocumentIntelligenceOcrSpec: ({ endpoint }) -> plain adapter spec for defineOcrAdapter; throws TypeError on a disallowed endpoint
exports.azureDocumentIntelligenceEndpoint: (credentials) -> the selected connection's endpoint origin (baseUrl, else providerSpecificData.baseUrl) or null
exports.azureDocumentIntelligenceOrigin: (value) -> bare https origin of an allowed Azure endpoint or null
exports.azureDocumentIntelligenceAnalyzeUrl: (origin, model) -> analyze URL with api-version and outputContentFormat
exports.azureDocumentIntelligencePollState: (json) -> running | succeeded | failed; throws on an undocumented state
exports.parseAzureDocumentIntelligenceResult: (raw, { model }) -> { model, pages: [{ index: 0, markdown }], usage_info? }; throws on a non-result

documents: base64 data URL of PDF, PNG, JPEG or TIFF
supportedSubset.polling: foundation default: 30 status checks, 1000 ms apart, one deadline for submit and polls, no replay

integrationPoints.change: for an azure-document-intelligence connection, resolve azureDocumentIntelligenceEndpoint(credentials); refuse locally when null; otherwise defineOcrAdapter(azureDocumentIntelligenceOcrSpec({ endpoint })) and dispatch with the same credentials
register the azure-document-intelligence provider with an endpoint field stored as providerSpecificData.baseUrl
